### Jacob Deceives Isaac
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jacob-deceives-isaac
Passage: Genesis 27:14-25
Points:
- Jacob secured Isaac's patriarchal blessing through deceit, but biblical clues show God did not condone his methods.
- Jacob's concern during the scheme was merely the fear of getting caught rather than a desire to honor his father.
- Sinful deception produces painful consequences, resulting in Jacob's immediate exile and his later experience of being deceived by Laban.
- God's sovereign redemptive plans cannot be thwarted by human frailty, yet His providence never serves as an excuse to sin.
